text:
rachel: Heads-up 1

We need a decision on the Invite Team Members form. Two sticky points: inline vs top-summary for single vs bulk invites (CSV paste), and revoke invite/delete member confirm patterns (typed, checkbox, undo). Prototype: https://figma.redwood/invite-flow

tom: For single invite flows: inline validation under each field (email/name). For CSV paste: always show a compact top summary listing rows with errors + counts (errors: 4, warnings: 1) with anchors to the parsed row.

jess: Agree. Inline for field edits, summary for bulk. Important: summary items must focus that row cell in the parsing preview and announce via SR. Example copy: "Row 3: invalid email 1 jump to row".

anika: Required markers: asterisk for simple fields; for role selector (complex) show persistent "Required" badge. Also include a top legend "* = required" on long dialogs. Avoid repeating the word required per input.

rachel: What about revoke confirmations? Ops wants typed-confirm for revoking org-admin invites. For normal pending invites maybe checkbox + undo toast.

tom: Suggest tiered rule: if invite has role=admin or affects >5 teams -> typed-confirm requiring phrase "revoke invite for <email>". Otherwise show checkbox + red CTA and an undo toast (10s). Record telemetry: confirm_type and undo_used.

jess: Accessibility: inline errors use aria-describedby; summary region use role="status" with aria-live="polite" for non-blocking or "assertive" for blocking submit. Anchor jump must set focus to the row and announce "row 3 errors: invalid email".

a11y-bot: a11y reminders: 1) error text should include the label (e.g., "Email 
























"), 2) asterisk must have sr-only "required" and contrast >=4.5:1, 3) typed-confirm input must have autocomplete="off" and aria-label repeating the instruction, 4) avoid layout shifts by reserving helper/error height.

rachel: Microcopy rules: never use lone "Invalid". Use "Email 
please enter a valid email address" or "Invite already sent to this address" for server-side. For typed-confirm prompt prefer exact short phrase; show masked long emails carefully.

tom: E2E test asks: summary anchors focus the parsed row, SR announces, typed-confirm exact-match enforced, undo restores invite state, countdown respects prefers-reduced-motion if used.

anika: Action items: rachel -> update figma with inline + csv-summary + three confirm variants; jess -> draft microcopy for 10 invite error cases and revoke prompts; tom -> telemetry + e2e list; a11y-bot -> publish checklist for implementers. I'll loop in PM for the rollout policy.

rachel: Thanks all 680 

Will push mocks by tomorrow and request a quick review.
